name: Stitch.ai
summary: All-in-one AI workspace for mail, calendar, notes, tasks, files and more, with the Stitchy assistant built in.
description: Stitch.ai brings mail, calendar, contacts, tasks, notes, sheets, slides, boards and files into one workspace, without a separate email client or third-party integrations to set up. Dual panels let you drag items together; Knots, tags and connections keep work organized. Stitchy, the built-in assistant, works across those surfaces.
features: Built-in mail, calendar, tasks, notes, sheets, slides, boards and files
